description:
No spec subject (consumer repo migration; Argos)

Stage: M6 (05b-stages-migration.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu. Common migration checklist items 1-12 from 05b apply.

Deliverable:
Argos PR: SHA ref to hex {:ancora, "~> 1.0"} with runtime: false; strip 257 execute: flags (zero realized_by and no realization_hashes.json exist); remove the SpecLedEx tracer from the mix.exs tracer stack (keep the 2 app-local tracers); config.yml rewritten to v1 carrying the overlap/duplicate_covers: info posture (90 standing findings under an ADR) into the new severities map; pre-armed drift/dangling keys die with the rewrite. Common checklist: dep swap; strip retired constructs (format/retired_construct zero on PR head proves it); config rewrite (config/unknown_key zero proves it) and record spec/requirement_unverified count plus severity choices in the migration ADR; overrides enumeration via mix spec.status for every empty-derived-set subject that should survive, with reasons in the ADR; prune zero-tag subjects with one authorizing ADR; bw sweep per retirement (bw list --all --grep "Advances: <id>"); clause accounting for reworded requirements in the PR description; rewrite .spec/AGENTS.md from the L12 template; rules swap via sync-agent-rules so ancora.md lands, delete .claude/rules/specled.md, grep-verify no .claude/ file mentions a retired command, flag, env var, or code; one-time audit that no spec-tagged test sits behind a CI-excluded ExUnit tag; delete tracked derived state where present. This PR is the canary: any surprise here is cheaper than on Atlas.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: Argos CI green end to end including the shim new path
- Behaviors to demonstrate: mix spec.check green on the PR head; format/retired_construct = 0; config/unknown_key = 0; migration ADR present with counts and override list; .claude/rules/specled.md absent; retired-vocabulary grep over .claude/ zero
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix spec.check --base origin/main and mix spec.status in Argos
  - Final tier: Argos CI green
  - Verifier tier: the PR checklist items 1-12 checked against the diff; no suite runs
- Standing bounce-class checks: every checklist item ticked in the PR description with evidence
- Call-site Integration: n/a (consumer migration)

Out of Scope (files):
- /Users/mz/src/ancora/**
- any other consumer repo
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- Argos: mix.exs, mix.lock, .spec/**, .claude/rules/**, .claude/** (grep-driven), CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CI config if it names retired flags

Out of Scope (intent):
- never config-off a code to get green without a line in the migration ADR saying so
- never edit spec text to dodge a finding; reworded requirements get clause accounting
- a red on an unpriced finding class stops this PR and is dispositioned against the registry

Merge gate:
- [ ] Argos CI green including the shim new path
- [ ] Checklist items 1-12 checked in the PR description
- [ ] Migration ADR merged with the PR
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

Gaps:
1. .spec/specs/platform-dev-env.spec.md ships a `must` requirement that this PR falsifies, and its bound test now asserts the opposite. Scenario platform.dev_env.sc_spec_check_sees_the_linked_worktree_diff (line 328) repeats it: given "The `make spec-check` and `make spec-check-full` recipes" (332), when "The source-level recipe gate inspects both targets", then "Each invocation appears before SpecLedEx runs..." (337). This PR deletes the spec-check-full target from make/worktree.mk and removes SpecLedEx entirely. The test carrying @moduletag spec: ["platform.dev_env.spec_check_branch_guard"] — worktree_spec_check_test.exs, re-pinned under disposition 3 — now asserts refute source matches "spec-check-full" (line 23). Ancora's gate cannot see this: it does not read make-target names out of natural-language statements, which is why spec.check and CI are both green. The ADR's "clause accounting is therefore empty" is literally true but incomplete — this is the one requirement the migration genuinely needed to reword, and rewording it is exactly what would have made the accounting non-empty. Remedy is small: drop the "and make spec-check-full" clause and swap SpecLedEx for ancora in the statement (181-183) and in the scenario given/when/then (332, 335, 337), then record those clauses in the PR's clause accounting and one ADR line. Consumer-visible cost of shipping as-is: Engage, Builder, and Atlas each carry the same platform.dev_env-style guard requirement, so the same stale-contract shape will repeat three more times if it is not caught here. That is precisely the class of surprise the canary exists to surface.
